email_subject: Application - Marketing Specialist at Denza Antwerp
email_body:
Dear Kun Wei,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing Specialist role at Denza Antwerp. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content, I am eager to bring my hands-on skills to a fast-growing luxury EV brand.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I have executed online campaigns, managed social media, and analyzed performance using Google Analytics and Search Console. I have experience in lead generation through website optimization and content creation, and I am comfortable coordinating with agency partners. My technical background allows me to understand and leverage digital tools effectively.

I am fluent in English and have a good command of Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+), and I hold a valid driving licence B. I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to Denza's local marketing efforts and help build brand awareness in Flanders.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Kun Wei,

I am writing to express my interest in the Marketing Specialist position at Denza Antwerp. As a digital marketer with a technical edge, I am drawn to the opportunity to drive brand awareness and lead generation for a premium EV brand in Flanders.

My experience spans SEO, content creation, and web management, with a strong focus on measurable results. In my freelance work, I built and optimized websites for clients, implementing technical SEO and structured data to improve search visibility. At Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and content management for client sites, using tools like Semrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics to track performance. I have also managed social media integration and created engaging content for various platforms.

While my background is primarily digital, I have a keen understanding of how online efforts translate to offline actions. I have coordinated with team members on campaign execution and have experience in organizing content for events and promotions. My technical skills allow me to quickly grasp new tools and systems, and I am confident in my ability to execute local marketing campaigns, manage digital lead channels, and analyze competitor intelligence.

I am fluent in English and have a working knowledge of Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+), and I am eager to further develop my language skills in a professional environment. I hold a valid driving licence B and am based in Zwijndrecht, close to Antwerp.

I am excited about the prospect of contributing to Denza's growth in Belgium and would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills align with your needs. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
